notes.title: Volt Patrol：Translation Update : Chinese + Russian
notes.notes:
With this update, Volt Patrol is now available in Chinese and Russian! 
It's up to you, russian and chinese friends, to drive around as stealthily as you can!

The game is also available in English and French ;)

notes.title: Update: Random Mode
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I wanted to let you play Volt Patrol again with new challenges. 
That's why I've worked to offer you a random mode.

The Random mode is unlocked by finishing the game in Classic mode.
This mode brings the following changes to the test of AIMOS:
- the combinations of the codes are random
- the codes are randomly placed on the environment or are held by the guards
- the guards' rounds are random
- special configurations for some rooms may appear 

This mode is made to renew the challenge and allow you to continue to enjoy the gameplay of Volt Patrol in new situations.

I hope you will enjoy this update :)

Now it's your turn to play!

notes.title: Patches Post-Release
notes.notes:
Hello !

Since its release, Volt Patrol has taken advantage of a few patches to adjust the gaming experience and here they are :

Adjustments:


Reducing the speed of some of the guards to give a slower timing for those passages that require speed.
Increasing the sound volume and the size of the visual effect showing the activation of the buttons turning off the projectors.
Added in the tutorial the fact that tight turns are not necessary to get to the end of the game as the use of this ability is not necessarily easy.
Fill in the dead spaces in the level design that make you think you had to go through them.
Adding marks on the ground to indicate save points.
Reducing the drone detection perimeter.
Different positioning of certain parking spaces and parked vehicles that made you think you had to pass through inadequate paths.
Addition of small rocks on the ground to help locate the path of drone patrols.
Adjustment of decryption timing.
Added text to help you better understand decryption or parking to hide.
Performance optimisation.
Adjustment of the time taken by the drones to check parking spaces.



Corrections :

 Some of you who launched the game in windowed mode saw the game in 4:3 resolution by default, now the game launches well in 16:9.
 Removed z-fighting (blinking visible when 2 planes are fighting for the same position).
 A drone could be lured out of its sector and could no longer spot you. This is no longer the case.
 Modification of a music that no longer stopped.



I hope these patches have improved your gaming experience!
